notes.title: "The Future You've Been Dreaming Of" patch is now available.
notes.notes:
A patch for "The Future You've Been Dreaming Of" has been released.
The fixes in this patch are as follows

Fixed a bug that prevented the use of some controllers.
Fixed other minor bugs.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to our customers.

notes.title: 『The Future You've Been Dreaming Of』July 15, 2022 Release（Japan time）
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34134139/580f92e4bffb3420f94a5adb96bf43d5d1a064f0.png[/img]

Take on the role of a Zashiki-Warashi, a house-bound spirit that can bring good fortune, and peer into Sachi's life (though she can't see you). You'll see some of her more vulnerable moments and have no choice but to intervene from time to time, but it's all to guide her toward a bright future!
